input.brief: emet: a plugin for Claude Code that takes a feature from idea to merged change on one approval; parallel workers in isolated worktrees, a review per wave, nothing merges when flagged. Named for the golem word emet (truth). The mascot is a gentle clay-and-moss golem in an overgrown, solarpunk world.

direction.name: The place carries it
direction.idea: For a place, the photograph is the argument. One full-bleed image of where you would be standing fills the first screen, and the design steps back: the name sits along the bottom edge like a film title, or small in a corner, and nothing else interrupts the view. The page that follows keeps that restraint: few words, large pictures, long pauses. The designer's work here is editing: choosing the one frame that makes someone want to be there, and then not covering it.
direction.composition: First screen: a single photograph at 100vw by 100svh, focal point kept clear of text. The name is set either very large (14–20vw) hugging the bottom edge with 16–24px of margin, or small (20–28px) top-left with a one-line description bottom-left. Navigation is two to four words in the top corners in the same small size. If text sits on the image, a soft neutral scrim under the text area only. Below, sections alternate between a short centred or left-set paragraph in a narrow column (max 52ch) with wide empty margins, and photographs shown large: one full-bleed, then a pair at different sizes, then one portrait offset to the right. Practical information (hours, address, rates, booking) is gathered once near the end in a plain two-column block.
direction.typography: A face with some grace for the name; small, calm, well-spaced text everywhere else. Sentence case. Body 17–19px with leading around 1.55.
direction.colour: Neutral paper or deep neutral ground chosen to flatter the photographs; text ink drawn from the darkest tone in the imagery. Colour lives in the pictures.
direction.imagery: The dealt set is the palette. Choose four to six photographs with the same light. The hero image must have a calm area for the name. Full-bleed or large with square corners; never thumbnails, never a carousel of ten.
direction.photoTreatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.
direction.richness: The photographs, at full size, uninterrupted. Empty paper around short text makes the next image land harder.
direction.pitfalls: A weak hero photograph cannot be fixed by typography; pick again. Do not stack a headline, a paragraph and two buttons on the image. Do not use a booking bar that covers the bottom of the view; one small action is enough.

hero.name: Title from the top edge to the bottom edge
hero.blueprint: One full-bleed photograph or film at 100vw by 100svh, with a horizon near half height and empty sky or darkness above. The headline is two lines in a heavy face at clamp(140px, 13vw, 200px), leading 0.85, pulled as far apart as the screen allows: line one flush to the 32px left margin with its cap line 72px from the top; line two indented 28vw (403px) and anchored to the bottom, its baseline 24px above the lower edge, running towards the right margin. Lay the hero out as a grid of three rows (`grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto`): line one in the first row, line two in the third, both spans of one `h1` with `display: contents`. The middle row leaves the picture clear apart from one supporting sentence at 18px, max 44ch, crossing the horizon at 48% of the height from 30vw, and the single action directly beneath it as a solid rectangular button with its label at 18px. The wordmark and two text links sit top-right on the 32px margin at 15px; the top-left belongs to line one. Choose a picture whose upper-left and lower-right are calm enough for the type, or lay a neutral scrim under those two corners only.
hero.mobile: Keep the two lines at 19vw: line one flush left on a 16px margin 88px down, line two right-aligned to the 16px margin with its baseline 20px above the bottom. The sentence at 17px and the action button sit between them on the left margin, at 46% of the height. The picture is re-cropped to portrait around the horizon.
hero.headline: Two words or short phrases, one per line, at most about 8 characters each.

photos.title: Texture
photos.note: wood, stone, walls and abstract surfaces
photos.treatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.

photos.alt: Raindrops scattered across a dark wet surface, close-up
Curving orange sandstone walls of a narrow slot canyon
Satellite view of turquoise water swirling against golden land
Dark pebbles scattered across smooth, wind-rippled peach sand

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Call and response column
sections.blueprint: The sequence is shown as what you give and what comes back, in one narrow column 560px wide starting at column 4, or on the page's text axis. Three exchanges, 88px apart. Each opens with a sentence at 20px medium that begins with its order word ('First, install it.' 'Then ask for a chart.'). 16px under it, the call: the literal thing the user enters, in a filled panel one tone off the ground, radius 8px, padding 20px. For a developer tool that is real code in `<pre><code>` at 14px with a working copy button; otherwise it is the product's own input holding real typed text. Under the call, indented 56px, the response: a true-size fragment marked data-ui showing what the product returns. The third response is the finished result and breaks out of the column, 760px wide, running to column 12. The heading, two to four words at 28px, sits 56px above the first sentence.
sections.mobile: The column fills the width with 20px margins. Calls and responses stack without the indent; a 24px gap and a lighter panel tone set the response apart. Code panels scroll sideways inside themselves. The final result runs edge to edge at true size, cropped on the right if wider.

sections.name: Cards crossing a held photograph
sections.blueprint: A wrapper about 350svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. On the stage one full-bleed photograph of the subject's ground (a landscape, a material, an aerial texture) stays still, darkened evenly with `filter: brightness(0.6)`. Over it a track of four to six cards travels from right to left as the page scrolls (a `translateX` tied to the wrapper's scroll progress), so one card is always near the centre and the next shows about 300px at the right edge. Each card is 720×560px, square corners, vertically centred with 170px of photograph above and below it: its top 68% is a photograph of one item (a room, a building, a stop on the route), its lower 32% a flat panel in one earth tone from the palette, a different tone per card at a similar lightness, holding the item's name at clamp(32px, 3vw, 48px) bottom-left with 28px padding and a two-line description at 16px right-aligned beside it. Cards are 40px apart. The section heading, two to four words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 68px) in the paper colour, sits top-left on the stage over the photograph before the first card arrives and moves out ahead of it. Keep the run under three screens; at its end the stage releases into the next section.
sections.mobile: No pin and no sideways travel. The photograph runs full-bleed as a 4:5 band under the heading at 9vw, and the cards follow it at full width minus 16px margins, 24px apart, each a 4:3 photograph over its colour panel 140px tall, with the name at 26px and the description at 16px.

sections.name: Rows with margin photographs
sections.blueprint: Everything hangs from one vertical axis at column 5, about 35% of the width. First the heading: a statement of up to five words at clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px) starting on the axis, vertically centred in an otherwise empty 70svh of ground. Then four or five benefit rows, each starting on the same axis: a title at clamp(28px, 3vw, 48px) and under it a paragraph of 34ch at 17px. Columns 1–4 stay empty. At the right margin each row carries one photograph, top-aligned with its title and deliberately unequal: 240px wide at 4:5 in one row, 320px at 3:2 in the next, 180px square after that. Rows are separated by 96–120px of space, not lines. On a saturated field, set all type in one pale ink and leave the photographs ungraded.
sections.mobile: The axis collapses to the left margin. The statement sits at 9vw in 50svh of empty ground. Each row stacks its title at 26px, the paragraph, then its photograph at alternating widths: 100%, 70% flush right, 55% flush left. 64px between rows.

sections.name: Wide photo, colour tile, facts
sections.blueprint: Top: a heading of two to four words at clamp(40px, 4vw, 60px) on the left margin, then 24px below it a three-line lead paragraph at 21–22px across columns 1–6. 72px lower, two tiles sit side by side with a 16px gap. The left tile spans columns 1–8: a landscape photograph at 16:10 with one radius (0 or 10px). A short paragraph of up to 35 words at 16px is set in a solid paper-colour block 320px wide with 20px padding, placed over the photograph's top-right corner and flush with both edges. The right tile spans columns 9–12 and is a flat palette colour, 60% of the photograph's height: it holds a simple inline SVG outline of the region or the floor plan as one filled shape, with one solid dot marking the location. Under the colour tile, four label and value pairs at 14px in a two-by-two grid: altitude, distance, season, local time.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9vw, lead at 18px. The photograph goes full width at 4:3 and its overlaid paragraph moves beneath it as ordinary text. The colour tile follows at full width and 3:2, and the four label and value pairs sit under it in two columns.

sections.name: Three photographs, then a field
sections.blueprint: Two parts with no gap between them. First, a strip of three photographs butted edge to edge across the full viewport, each one third wide and 40svh tall, `object-fit: cover`, no gutters and no captions; give all three the same treatment. Directly beneath, a band in one flat palette colour, about 44svh tall. In the band, columns 1–7: the closing statement at 26–30px over three lines in the band's assigned ink, with exactly one phrase underlined by a 4px bar (`text-decoration-thickness: 4px; text-underline-offset: 6px`), and that phrase is the link; two lines at 16px follow 32px lower. In the lower-right corner, columns 11–12, a small portrait photograph (4:5, about 150px wide) sits 40px from the band's edges: the person who will answer. There is no button; the underlined phrase is the action.
sections.mobile: The strip becomes one full-width photograph at 4:3 with the other two side by side beneath it at half width each, still gutterless. The band follows: statement at 22px, the two small lines, and the portrait at 96px wide in the bottom-right corner.

sections.name: Photograph half, menu half
sections.blueprint: A split footer one viewport tall. The left half is a single photograph filling columns 1–6 edge to edge, cropped hard by the left and bottom viewport edges: a close crop of the page's main subject, larger than it appeared anywhere above. The right half, on a flat field, is the site's menu set large: five or six section names stacked as links at about 2.6vw bold, 28px apart, starting at column 8 and 80px from the top. Rows are separated by space only; on hover a row's label shifts right by 12px and the others drop to the softer ink. Under the menu, 64px lower, two short blocks at 15px side by side: contact and social. The legal line runs along the very bottom of the right half at 12px. The wordmark sits small at the top of the right half, on the menu's left edge.
sections.mobile: The photograph leads at full width and 50svh, cropped tight. The menu follows on the flat field at 8vw per item with 20px between items, then contact and social stacked at 15px, then the legal line at 12px. The wordmark sits small above the menu.

references.name: Tengile Malamala Collection
references.idea: Let the land and animals carry everything: one staggered hairline-serif headline over aerial footage, then cream pages of olive-green serif text with photographs placed at uneven sizes.
references.hero: Aerial river footage fills the viewport, slightly darkened. Three small white caps items sit on the top edge: an enquiry link hard left, a stacked three-line wordmark centred, 'menu' hard right. The headline is two words on two lines in thin serif capitals about 8.3vw tall: the first line starts 10% from the left, the second is indented to 40% and ends near 90%, so the pair steps diagonally across the middle third. Below, starting at the 50% line, a three-line serif sentence at about 20px and a small white square-cornered button with a separate arrow square beside it. The lower third is left to the water.
references.type: PP Fragment at hairline weight (220): capitals for the 120px headline, sentence case for 28-36px olive statements. Inter at 11-16px for labels, nav and small paragraphs. Three serif sizes, two sans sizes; the serif never goes bold.
references.colour: #f5eee9 #5c6e21 #181608 #e3e1d4 #ffffff — Warm cream page with every word, large or small, in one olive green; the footer inverts to a solid olive field with cream text. Photography supplies all other colour.
references.imagery: Wildlife and lodge photography, natural and saturated, square corners, no overlays. Mixed aspect ratios placed at different widths and vertical offsets; lodge listings use equal landscape triplets; hero and closing band are full-bleed aerials.
references.layout: Narrow 16px outer margins and a twelve-column grid used asymmetrically: label and small paragraph in the left columns, the large statement starting at the midpoint. Sections alternate between loosely scattered image pairs and tidy three-up rows.

sections.description: Cream field. A tiny sans caps label top-left. A 28px olive serif paragraph of eight lines occupies only the right half, starting at the midpoint. Far below on the left, a five-line 12px sans paragraph about 180px wide. Images are placed loose: a landscape elephant photo under the right text, a tall leopard portrait lower at the left margin, a wide crop of elephant legs upper right of the next screen. No two share a top edge or width.

A tiny caps label, then an olive serif statement at about 36px running the full width for four lines. Beneath: a sub-label, a 12px paragraph held to a third of the width, then three equal landscape photos with 8px gutters spanning margin to margin, each captioned below in small serif. The same block repeats for a second category; one tile is dimmed with a short caps line laid over it to mark it as not yet open.

A full-bleed aerial of an elephant crossing a sandbank with a short serif statement, a small sans paragraph and the white button-plus-arrow pair set in the right half only. It butts directly against a solid olive footer: five columns of small cream links under tiny caps headings in the top third, a large empty green area beneath, and a legal line along the bottom edge.

steal: Stagger a two-line headline: first line from the left margin, second indented by 30% so the pair steps diagonally across the image.
Set every piece of text in a single brand colour on cream and make the footer that same colour as a solid field.
Split the button into two adjacent squares, label and arrow, with a 4px gap, small and square-cornered, instead of one pill.
references.media: A 10s muted aerial montage covers the whole first screen with type set on it and no visible scrim. Below: a split with an image and paragraph in the right half from the centre line, staggered image pairs with uneven heights and offsets, a three-up card row with captions, an inset full-width slider, a constellation of thumbnails round a centred heading, a slow portrait marquee, and a sticky full-bleed landscape with the closing call scrolling over it; 33 images, pictures oversized about 110% in their masks for drift.
references.motion: There is no preloader and only the montage cuts after 400ms, but under Lenis content stays hidden until each reveal fires: blocks rise and sharpen from a blur over 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), others fade with a filter over 1s cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1), pictures drift inside their masks, and the closing landscape holds on a sticky root. The ground steps from cream to sage-beige to olive, and the marquee loops on 120s.

references.name: Eagle’s Nest
references.idea: Let the lake view do the selling: full-bleed footage of the volcano horizon with the name set as a monumental cream serif along the bottom edge.
references.hero: Full-bleed video of a silhouetted figure meditating before a lake and volcanoes, with no scrim. The name is set in a high-contrast cream serif, uppercase, about 15vw, spanning the full width between 34px margins and sitting on the bottom edge so it covers the lower fifth of the frame. Directly above its left and right ends sit two pairs of small white labels (what it is, where it is). Top row: a round emblem far left, eight plain text links grouped right of centre and an outlined pill button far right. A small black vertical awards tab hangs on the right edge.
references.type: PP Pangaia medium: uppercase at 216px for the wordmark, mixed case with uncial-flavoured alternates for section titles. PP Neue Montreal for nav and body at 16px, with a lead paragraph near 22px. Two faces and about four sizes.
references.colour: #fffae7 #0e2404 #3f6f8c #2d5c8a #5d9aa3 #040303 — Photography supplies lake blues and timber browns. Content sits on warm cream with deep green or lake-blue serif headings, and the footer inverts to very dark forest green with cream type.
references.imagery: Wide landscape video and saturated photos of the lake, bamboo structures and yoga; full-bleed for scene-setters, otherwise inset cards with a small radius. A flat teal vector map of Central America sits beside the main photo.
references.layout: Thirty screens alternating pinned full-bleed photographs with cream content bands. Tight 17-34px outer margins; content is left-anchored with images running to the right margin, and value chapters use centred titles. The recurring serif holds the long page together.

sections.description: A cream band slides up over the hero. A dark green serif heading at about 4vw sits top-left, followed by a three-line lead paragraph near 22px across half the width. Below, a wide landscape photo card takes about 70% of the width with a short white paragraph overlaid in its top-right corner. To its right is a narrower teal map card with one location dot, and beneath it four tiny label and value pairs, including live local time.

A large blue serif title centred on cream shrinks into a small centred label pinned just above a full-bleed photograph. The photo stays fixed while single value words appear one at a time at its centre in white serif at about 4vw, each with two lines of small centred text beneath. One image carries several sequential captions.

Very dark green field. The top row is split in three: postal address in small sans at left, the section menu as a column of serif links at about 24px starting at the centre line, and social links right-aligned at the far right. The wordmark repeats at full width along the bottom edge at hero size, caught rising letter by letter. Tiny credits sit beneath.

steal: Anchor the name at full width on the bottom edge of a full-bleed video and tuck two tiny descriptor pairs above its left and right ends.
Pin one photograph and cycle one-word captions over it instead of building a card for each value.
Place a small facts stack (elevation, temperature, live local time) beside a flat map to ground a destination.

references.name: The Content Architecture
references.idea: The product name becomes a rotating vortex of concentric text rings that you scroll into, and the sales argument is a ticking hours-lost counter beside an itemised receipt.
references.hero: Exact 50/50 vertical split. The left half is warm cream with a left-aligned stack starting a third of the way down at an 80px margin: one-line mono caps label, a two-line medium-weight sans headline at only 3vw, a four-line grey paragraph capped near 510px, then a black button notched into two joined halves beside a pale grey secondary. A mono scroll cue with a target glyph sits bottom-left. The right half is a charcoal canvas filled with concentric rings of white mono caps spiralling round a centre and cropped by the viewport. A dark boxed nav with a marquee strip floats top-centre across the seam; a minimap thumbnail sits top-right.
references.type: GeistMono carries two thirds of the page: caps labels, nav, buttons and receipt rows with dot leaders. GeistSans 500 sets quiet 43px sentence-case headlines with zero tracking. The only loud size is a counter numeral near 18vw, so three sizes in total.
references.colour: #f1eee7 #232323 #dedede #f28a1c #000000 — Warm cream and charcoal trade places section by section. A single small orange dot marks the paid action on the button and nav; no other hue appears.
references.imagery: No photographs. Canvas-drawn concentric rings of the product name in white mono over a faint dotted grid, later dissolving into scattered glyphs and inverted text fragments. Full-bleed and cropped by the viewport.
references.layout: An 80px left margin holds every text block. Headlines stay small at the top-left of tall cream sections while one oversized element (vortex, numeral, receipt) takes the opposite side. Floating nav, minimap and a help tab stay pinned throughout.

sections.description: Scroll transition between hero and first section: the camera pushes into the text vortex, rings scaling until letters are hundreds of pixels tall and cropped at every edge, the dotted grid showing between them. A solid cream disc opens at the centre and grows until it becomes the next section's background. A full-screen wipe built from the hero's own artwork, with the nav still floating above.

Pinned cream section. Top-left, a three-line 43px headline with a two-line grey note. Bottom-left, a tilde-prefixed numeral about 18vw tall counts from 00 to 24 as you scroll, with a mono caption and small chip beneath. On the right a receipt column framed by dashed rules fills line by line: mono caps rows grouped by day, dot leaders running to right-aligned hour values, the newest row inverted white on black.

The cream page ends in a band where the vortex returns as debris: tiny mono fragments, some inverted in black boxes, scattered sparsely and thickening upward into the dark ring pattern. Below it a plain footer: logo mark with a stacked two-line name on the left, two short mono caps link columns on the right, and a builder credit bottom-right.

steal: Split the primary button into two notched halves so a two-word action reads like a physical ticket, with one orange dot as the page's only accent.
Argue the cost of doing nothing with a pinned counter: a huge numeral ticks up while itemised mono rows with dot leaders append beside it.
Build the hero graphic from the brand name set on concentric rotating rings, then reuse it as the scroll transition and as footer debris.
